svg.title: Themes
svg.desc: Light, Dark and AMOLED use the same Clover geometry and bundled Roboto. Neutral grounds retain Orbin green branding and contrast-safe reference-inspired text roles.
svg.metadata: Diagram-only Roboto glyph subsets preserving source outlines and metrics; Apache-2.0. Regular source is actual API31 reference-runtime StaticRegular, SHA256 06cba01eb71ea5cbd3a7df498910624db68953beead4be18fd91f8ec7dc72351. Medium source is exact supplied Clover APK Roboto-Medium, SHA256 6e2ec5c5f89e4ce302bb93b46cb7cc336236501de17348e284878914c5e0e723. Full source fonts, hashes and licensing remain in ui-next composeResources/files/licenses. Diagram text uses only weights400 and500.
svg.text: Clover 3.0.2 geometry · Orbin green branding · dimensions in dp
Text and geometry remain identical across themes.
